name: dailyrecap
description: Auto-generate today's decision recap from your AI coding session logs and record it to Obsidian / local Markdown. BYOK.
author: nostos-lab

recap.provider.description: LLM provider. v1 is fixed to anthropic.

recap.model.description: Anthropic model to use. Check the latest model names at https://docs.claude.com

recap.source.description: Raw-material source. 'session' (Claude Code session logs) preferred, with 'git' fallback.

recap.outputDir.description: Output directory for local Markdown recaps.

recap.obsidianVault.description: Absolute path to the Obsidian vault.

recap.lang.description: Recap output language. 'auto' follows the editor locale.

enumDescriptions: Enrich only when the session's own result signal (changed files / tool results) is weak
recap.gitEnrich.description: How to enrich the recap's "result" axis with the same day's git commits and changed files.

scripts.test: for f in parser prompt llm sink e2e git fusion; do node --experimental-strip-types --import ./test/register-ts.mjs test/$f.test.ts || exit 1; done
